project_derivatives.source: User-supplied creator video originals for Kajal Karmakar's YouTube listings RRyXHZKOYGc (Transition 01) and dAZGvwAzupY (Transition 02); direct use was authorized in the 2026-09-29 assignment. Official YouTube oEmbed metadata confirmed the creator and exact titles. The supplied files, not streamed viewer media, are the acquisition masters.
project_derivatives.transformation: scripts/process-leaf-mattes.sh reproducibly decodes the inspected 1280x720 H.264 black-backed originals without source audio, applies FFmpeg colorkey black similarity 0.15/blend 0.07, unpremultiplies black-contaminated RGB, replaces RGB only on the keyed edge from alpha-weighted neighbours, contracts alpha fractionally from each pixel and its four-neighbour minimum, and VP9 alpha-encodes at 1280x720/30 fps. This avoids blanket erosion of dark leaf interiors. Native-size composites were inspected over cream and dark green. Both clips play at 1.35x while decoded media time remains the synchronization clock. Opaque source-frame WebP holds at 3.033 seconds and 1.933 seconds briefly sit above the alpha movies during commit, closing isolated keyed points without layering a moving edge over a different leaf frame. Transition 01 keeps native framing and commits at 3.03-3.80 seconds. Transition 02 retains its centered 1.9x runtime crop, commits at 1.90-2.00 seconds and retains the opaque hold through 2.60 seconds so the narrow decoded native interval cannot be skipped. The unused supplied Transition 03 master remains outside public delivery.

project_derivatives.source: User-supplied bird-orange.zip; USER-PROVIDED CLEARANCE. The archive contains no licence document, so no named public licence is claimed.
project_derivatives.transformation: Pinned Three.js parsed the supplied FBX. The 40 exported skin bones and 86-track Take 001 were retained; one visible rig-control line was neutralized and five flat rear-feather components were omitted from the public camera derivative while the original FBX stayed untouched. The supplied RGB base colour was resized to 1024px WebP and explicitly remapped. Runtime authors the missing world-space entrance, with three anticipation/airborne/landing/recovery hops around the right post, and reuses Take 001 with named head, neck, tail, ankle and toe bones. Quiet idle actions are separated by rests. Three reactions culminate in four planted hop-steps through a full 360-degree turn and return to the same perch.

project_derivatives.source: Previously retained CC0 sources clgood 688618 and OwlStorm 151220, plus CC0 MrPugles 621965 pencil scratches and BenjaminNelan 353125 paper rustle for materially different fourth takes.
project_derivatives.transformation: The established three-file pools remain intact and each role gains one non-overlapping fourth take from a second matching material source. Pen roles use discrete pencil gestures; paper roles use a separate natural sheet rustle, with settling roles reversed only where that matches the physical action. Runtime still uses the existing per-action shuffle bag, prevents immediate repeats across refills, and excludes failed decodes.

project_derivatives.source: CC0 Freesound recordings: se2001 510314 Happy Bird Chirp and TRP 575223 Dry leaf.
project_derivatives.transformation: Three short non-species-labelled chirps are non-overlapping trims with edge fades and restrained loudness. Each exact leaf video has a quiet filtered rustle bed plus a three-file dry overlap-accent pool. Playback crosses cue times from decoded video mediaTime, once per run, and fades/stops on reveal, interruption, failure, hidden tab or unmount.

project_derivatives.source: LiezelDippenaar, Marble (single) rolling on wooden floor.wav, Freesound sound 707545, CC0. The source is an actual small object rolling on wood; it is not represented as an apple field recording.
project_derivatives.transformation: A 0.90-2.15 second irregular rolling passage was pitch-shifted down to 0.82x without preserving duration, converted to mono 48 kHz, high-passed at 90 Hz, low-passed at 1.8 kHz, lightly compressed, level-adjusted and edge-faded. Runtime begins only when presented apple travel increases, joins late at the matching progress offset, tapers with the roll, and stops on rest, reversal, interruption, visibility loss or teardown.

project_derivatives.source: User-supplied SKETCH-PREVIEW.png, reused at the user's request. The separately described original sketch sheet and transparent crop masters were not present in the delivered filesystem, so no artist or independent licence is asserted.
project_derivatives.transformation: Exact drawing regions were cropped at the dimensions named by the standalone brief (144x124, 149x110 and 134x85). Transparency was derived from the preview's uniform #f5f1e6 paper colour with FFmpeg colorkey; no drawing was generated, traced, smoothed or redrawn. Empty alt text, an aria-hidden group and pointer-events none keep the decorative studies out of controls and the accessibility tree.
